# Gzipped XBRL fixtures

Verbatim XBRL files from SEC EDGAR, gzip-compressed (`gzip -n -9`, so the bytes are
reproducible) because the uncompressed set is about 90 MB and compressed it is about 6 MB.
Gzip is lossless: decompressing a file gives back exactly what SEC served. Never edit a
file here. To replace one, download it again from SEC and recompress it.

Tests decompress a filing's files into a temporary directory and load them with
`XBRL.from_directory()`. For every filing below, that gives the same income statement and
balance sheet (both `detailed` and `standard` views, the statement role, and the
definition-linkbase answer) as `filing.xbrl()` on the live filing. This was checked on
2026-11-22 before the files were committed.

Each directory holds the filing's instance (`*_htm.xml`), schema (`*.xsd`) and linkbases
(`_cal`, `_def`, `_lab`, `_pre`), plus a plain-text `filing_metadata.txt`. SLB embeds its
linkbases in the schema, so its directory has only the instance and the schema. The
directory name is the fiscal year of the report's period end, taken from the instance
filename.

Used by `tests/issues/regression/test_issue_68lp_gh577_validation.py`.
